# 藁一本の約束 v0.3

Main app: https://wara.monku.ai/
Concept and original offline mock: https://github.com/kentaroid-bot/emergency-straw-protocol
README.md and protocol.json describe the current model. One wallet has 10 INA (formerly Kusa) per JST day across communities. Each INA mints 90 WARA to the shop and 10 to the buyer. Issuer-specific mints persist. SMS is simulated; signed settlement is on Solana Devnet. /devnet/ and LEGACY-v02.md document the older independent 300-limit system.
